stem: What explains why a coin at the bottom of a pool of water seems closer to the surface than it really is?

options.label: A
options.text: Light reflects from the surface of the water.

options.label: B
options.text: Light reflected from the coin changes direction as it leaves the water.

options.label: C
options.text: Light travels only in straight lines after being reflected.

options.label: D
options.text: Light reflected from the coin is absorbed by the water.

visual_elements: icons indicating a multiple choice question
